sources.title: Inside Harvey: How a first-year legal associate built one of Silicon Valley's hottest startups
Harvey CEO Winston Weinberg on re-earning roles, career advice and building an $11 billion AI startup
sources.quote_checked: You have to re-earn your position every six months; you need to re-earn your role at Harvey every six months. | It includes me, 100%.

sources.title: How Harvey AI is Changing the Legal Industry with Winston Weinberg
sources.quote_checked: trust is the most important thing in professional services | if you earn the trust of a few of those firms, the rest of them will trust you | One of the hardest things about being an application layer company is you have to bet on model providers | you want to build systems that the next generation of model cannot do | these models weren't going to just automate entire industries away | accuracy is more important than creativity, to be clear here

sources.title: Harvey's CEO tells BI: Don't sleep on junior lawyers in the age of AI
sources.quote_checked: AI systems can do the work, but there's no reason you can't turn those into education platforms. | In 10 years, they're going to be a way better partner.

sources.title: Harvey CEO shares his advice to young lawyers — and those considering pivoting into legal tech
sources.quote_checked: the biggest thing a lawyer who wants to work in the tech space should do is build up tolerance for failure | are often practiced perfectionists, and startups are all about risk, reward, and resilience
